name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: JavaScript
description: Adversaries may abuse JavaScript to execute malicious code, including cross-site scripting delivered to browsers and server-side JavaScript such as Node.js. JavaScript and JScript can be executed by browsers, the Windows Script Host, and application runtimes to run attacker-controlled logic.
detection: Monitor for execution of script interpreters and browser telemetry indicating injected or malicious scripts. Web application logs may show reflected or stored cross-site scripting payloads in parameters and stored content.
mitigations: M1038: Execution Prevention — restrict script execution
M1021: Restrict Web-Based Content — enforce Content Security Policy
